name: Underwater ripple
summary: Blue-green underwater tint with drifting caustic light lines and small bubbles rising through the frame.

params.name: intensity
params.note: strength of tint, caustics and bubbles, 0 to 1

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
